# About this site
# Healing with Attia — Online Therapy & Marriage Counseling in Pakistan & for the Pakistani diaspora

Therapist: Attia Altaf, Integrative Psychotherapist (CPCAB UK certified, Level 3 & 4 Diploma; PhD)
Services: Online therapy for depression, anxiety, OCD (including religious OCD / waswasa), trauma & PTSD, postnatal depression, burnout, marriage counseling, pre-marital counseling
Languages: Urdu, English, Punjabi
Format: Online via Zoom, 50-minute sessions, PKR 5,000 flat fee, no waiting list, booking via WhatsApp
Serving: Pakistan (Islamabad, Lahore, Karachi & nationwide) and the Pakistani diaspora in the UK, UAE (Dubai, Abu Dhabi), Saudi Arabia (Riyadh, Jeddah), and worldwide
Contact: https://wa.me/923285694209
Website: https://www.healingwithattia.com
